h1: Tukteaw Hostel Khon Kaen — a clean, budget stay within walking distance of Ton Tann Market
intro: If you're visiting Khon Kaen on a tight budget but still want a clean private room close to great food, Tukteaw Hostel is a name that keeps coming up · A small 18-room hostel that opened in 2020, it sits on Mittraphap Road in the city centre, just a short walk from Ton Tann Market, one of the city's favourite food and night-market spots · Rooms are clean and minimalist, there's free parking, a shared kitchen and free snacks & drinks at the pantry · Guests single out the staff as especially friendly and helpful · From approx. ฿650/night

body.html: Tukteaw Hostel is a small property that opened in 2020, set right on Mittraphap Road in Nai Mueang, central Khon Kaen · The headline draw guests mention from the start is the location — it's only a few hundred metres' walk from Ton Tann Market, a popular food and night-market area · It's about 1.4 km from Khon Kaen railway station and roughly 16 minutes' drive from the airport · It suits solo travellers, budget-minded couples, or anyone passing through Khon Kaen for a night or two who would rather be out eating and exploring than sitting in their room.

There are 18 rooms in total, all in a tidy minimalist style · Options run from Standard (no window) and Superior (with window) up to a 16 m² Deluxe and a 20 m² Balcony Room · Guests particularly praise how clean and new the rooms feel, with good hot water and water pressure · Beds are made and towels changed daily · Worth knowing: the windowless Standard rooms can feel stuffy for some, and a few reviews mention firm mattresses — if either matters to you, book a room with a window or balcony.
"Clean, fresh-looking room, good hot water and pressure, lovely and helpful staff. Ton Tann Market is just a few minutes' walk with loads of food. Great value at this price."

What wins over budget travellers is the service and the little extras · There's a pantry kept stocked with free snacks and drinks to help yourself to, a shared kitchen for cooking your own meals, laundry service and a small in-house cafe · Free parking is a real convenience for anyone driving · The front desk is open 24 hours, there's an elevator, and they'll help arrange transfers · The thing guests rate highest, though, is the friendly, helpful staff, which makes the whole place feel warmer than the price suggests.

The trade-off of a Mittraphap Road location is traffic noise · Reviews mention noise from the main road that can carry day and night, especially in rooms facing the street or with a window or balcony — some guests say they could still hear it with earplugs in · If you're a light sleeper, the interior rooms away from the road are quieter, but that means no window · A few scattered reviews also note ants in a room and a slightly wonky tap, which staff sorted out when told.

Honestly, Tukteaw Hostel suits people who want a clean, cheap stay within walking distance of food more than those who need quiet or full facilities · If you're in Khon Kaen to eat and explore, staying just a night or two, and aren't fussed about road noise, it offers value that's hard to find at this price · Review scores sit in good territory on both Trip.com and Agoda (around 8.6–9.1), reflecting that most guests are happy — especially with cleanliness, staff and location · The main gripes circle back to road noise and firm mattresses in some rooms.

A tip from reading the reviews: if you sleep lightly, ask for an interior room away from the road, or pack earplugs · For natural light and a less boxed-in feel, choose a Superior or Balcony Room with a window or balcony over the Standard · For dinner, just walk to Ton Tann Market right nearby for plenty of choice — no driving needed · And if you've come by car, make the most of the free parking rather than hunting for a spot outside.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Tukteaw Hostel Khon Kaen

faq.q: Where is Tukteaw Hostel Khon Kaen and how do I get there?
faq.a: It's at 381/27 Mittraphap Road, Nai Mueang, in central Khon Kaen · It's a short walk (about 200 m) to the popular Ton Tann food market · It's roughly 1.4 km from Khon Kaen railway station and about 16 minutes' drive from the airport · Central Plaza, Bueng Kaen Nakhon and Khao Niao Road are about 10 minutes by car.

faq.q: How much does Tukteaw Hostel cost and what rooms are there?
faq.a: Rates start at about ฿650/night for a Standard Room (double bed, no window) · A Superior Room with a window starts around ฿800 · The 16 m² Deluxe is around ฿900 and the 20 m² Balcony Room (with balcony) around ฿1,050 · Prices vary by date and package, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: What are the rooms like at Tukteaw Hostel — are they clean?
faq.a: Rooms are tidy and minimalist, and guests particularly praise how clean and new they feel · Hot water and water pressure are good, and beds are made and towels changed daily · Worth knowing: the windowless Standard rooms can feel stuffy and some mattresses are quite firm — if that matters, book a room with a window or balcony.

faq.q: Is Tukteaw Hostel noisy — is it okay for light sleepers?
faq.a: It's on Mittraphap Road, a main road, and reviews mention traffic noise that can carry day and night, especially in street-facing rooms or those with a window or balcony · If you're a light sleeper, ask for an interior room away from the road, or bring earplugs.

faq.q: Does Tukteaw Hostel have parking and what amenities are there?
faq.a: There's free parking, free Wi-Fi, a shared kitchen, laundry service, a small cafe and a 24-hour front desk · A favourite touch is the pantry kept stocked with free snacks and drinks · There's an elevator and the staff can help arrange transfers — basics covered with friendly service in true hostel style.

faq.q: Who is Tukteaw Hostel best for?
faq.a: It's best for solo travellers, budget-minded couples, or anyone passing through Khon Kaen for a night or two to eat and explore · If you want a clean stay in the hundreds-of-baht range within walking distance of food, and you're not fussed about road noise or luxury amenities, it offers value that's hard to find at this price.
